title: Lyon Air Museum

services.name: Facility Rental
services.desc: Nestled in the heart of Orange County on the west side of John Wayne Airport, our 30,000 square foot hangar features a pristine collection of historic aircraft and classic vehicles from World War II era. These exhibits are true pieces of living history and provide a wealth of knowledge that fascinates and inspires visitors of all ages. Our facility is a unique event venue that provides an ideal setting for galas, corporate events, memorial service, anniversaries, birthdays, holiday parties, fashion shows, and wedding receptions.
